clusters.name: The turtl app
clusters.summary: The screens you use to see cases, read what happened and respond.

clusters.name: Case handling
clusters.summary: Turns problems into cases and moves each through its steps from detection to learning.

clusters.name: Health checks
clusters.summary: Regularly tests the booking app, raises problems, and confirms after a fix that it works again.

clusters.name: Finding the cause
clusters.summary: Gathers clues, asks OpenAI for a diagnosis and plans fix options.

clusters.name: Owner approvals
clusters.summary: Asks you before acting, texts you through Keiki, and applies the fix you approve.

clusters.name: What turtl remembers
clusters.summary: Saves what worked, recalls it when a similar problem comes back, and answers your questions in chat.

clusters.name: Code map
clusters.summary: Draws this map of your app's code from GitHub, keeps the code in Supermemory, and answers your questions about any part of it.

clusters.name: Booking
clusters.summary: The demo booking app turtl protects: its booking screen, services and times, saved bookings, and the web links turtl uses to check it.

clusters.name: Recommendations
clusters.summary: Suggests services while a customer books. When the suggestion provider is slow, booking waits on it; turning suggestions off lets booking go through.

clusters.name: Testing tools
clusters.summary: Sample cases and buttons for trying turtl without a real outage.

app/_layout.tsx.label: App shell
app/_layout.tsx.summary: Sets up the turtl app and connects it to the live data, so every screen shows current cases.

app/case/[id].tsx.label: Case screen
app/case/[id].tsx.summary: Shows one case as a set of swipeable cards covering what broke, the cause, the plan and the result.

app/index.tsx.label: Case list
app/index.tsx.summary: Lists all cases, putting the ones waiting for your decision first.

components/dev/DevTools.tsx.label: Test panel
components/dev/DevTools.tsx.summary: A panel of buttons for creating sample cases and running a demo recovery without a real outage.

components/dev/useDevActions.ts.label: Test buttons
components/dev/useDevActions.ts.summary: Connects the test panel's buttons to the actions that create, advance and reset sample cases.

components/feed/CardPage.tsx.label: Case card
components/feed/CardPage.tsx.summary: Draws one card of a case, with its status, details and any decision or permission controls.

components/feed/CaseKindChip.tsx.label: Case type tag
components/feed/CaseKindChip.tsx.summary: A small tag showing what kind of case this is and who raised it.

components/feed/CaseRow.tsx.label: Case list row
components/feed/CaseRow.tsx.summary: One row in the case list showing the case title, status and how long ago it started.

components/feed/DecisionPanel.tsx.label: Approve or decline
components/feed/DecisionPanel.tsx.summary: Buttons to approve or decline a proposed fix, with a confirmation step before your choice is sent.

components/feed/PermissionPanel.tsx.label: Allow automatic fixes
components/feed/PermissionPanel.tsx.summary: Buttons to let turtl reuse a past fix automatically, or take that permission back, after a confirmation.

components/feed/ProgressStrip.tsx.label: Progress bar
components/feed/ProgressStrip.tsx.summary: A strip of segments showing how far a case has moved through its steps.

components/feed/StatusBadge.tsx.label: Status badge
components/feed/StatusBadge.tsx.summary: A small coloured label showing a status such as waiting for you or restored.

components/feed/cards.ts.label: Card progress
components/feed/cards.ts.summary: Groups a case's steps into the cards you see and chooses their labels and colours.

components/feed/incident.ts.label: Incident wording
components/feed/incident.ts.summary: Works out the text shown on each card of a real incident, such as cause, plan and result.

convex/assistant.ts.label: Ask turtl chat
convex/assistant.ts.summary: Answers your questions in chat using OpenAI, drawing on what turtl has saved about past cases.

convex/bookingDemo/booking.ts.label: Booking actions
convex/bookingDemo/booking.ts.summary: Lets the demo app list services, show feature switches, suggest services and submit a booking.

convex/bookingDemo/catalog.ts.label: Services and times
convex/bookingDemo/catalog.ts.summary: Holds the demo app's list of services and bookable time slots.

convex/bookingDemo/checks.ts.label: Booking test run
convex/bookingDemo/checks.ts.summary: Runs a full test booking on the demo app and reports whether it worked.

convex/bookingDemo/journeyCore.ts.label: Booking steps
convex/bookingDemo/journeyCore.ts.summary: Carries out a booking from start to finish, including optional suggestions and saving, and reports any error.

convex/bookingDemo/provider.ts.label: Service suggestions
convex/bookingDemo/provider.ts.summary: Provides suggested services for a booking and can be made to time out to stage a failure.

convex/bookingDemo/records.ts.label: Booking records
convex/bookingDemo/records.ts.summary: Saves, reads and cleans up bookings and failed attempts, and counts how many people were affected.

convex/bookingDemo/state.ts.label: Suggestions switch
convex/bookingDemo/state.ts.summary: Keeps the demo app's switches: whether suggestions are on, and the staged slow-provider and booking-store failures.

convex/bookingDemo/validators.ts.label: Booking error format
convex/bookingDemo/validators.ts.summary: Defines the shape of the error details the booking app returns when something goes wrong.

convex/cases.ts.label: Case records
convex/cases.ts.summary: Creates cases, keeps their status and steps up to date, and supplies the data the app screens show.

convex/constants.ts.label: Case steps and statuses
convex/constants.ts.summary: Lists the eight steps a case goes through and the statuses a case can have.

convex/crons.ts.label: Check schedule
convex/crons.ts.summary: Sets the timetable that makes turtl check the booking app regularly.

convex/decisions.ts.label: Approval decisions
convex/decisions.ts.summary: Records your approval or decline of a proposed fix and moves the case on.

convex/dev.ts.label: Sample case tools
convex/dev.ts.summary: Creates, advances and resets sample cases and starts demo recoveries for testing.

convex/diagnosis.ts.label: Cause diagnosis
convex/diagnosis.ts.summary: Asks OpenAI to work out the likely cause of a problem from the evidence gathered.

convex/http.ts.label: Booking app web links
convex/http.ts.summary: Web addresses for the booking app: health, version, switches, test booking and error reports, with protected ones needing a secret.

convex/keiki.ts.label: Text messages
convex/keiki.ts.summary: Texts you through Keiki when a case opens or needs your decision.

convex/memory/checks.ts.label: Memory matching rules
convex/memory/checks.ts.summary: Decides whether a saved fix still applies to a new problem and how to confirm it worked.

convex/memory/dev.ts.label: Memory test tools
convex/memory/dev.ts.summary: Creates and breaks sample memories to test how recall behaves.

convex/memory/flow.ts.label: Find past fixes
convex/memory/flow.ts.summary: Looks for a saved fix that matches the current problem.

convex/memory/records.ts.label: Saved fixes
convex/memory/records.ts.summary: Stores, reads and checks remembered fixes and the evidence behind them.

convex/memory/service.ts.label: Learn and recall
convex/memory/service.ts.summary: Saves what worked after a case and recalls matching past fixes for new ones.

convex/monitor.ts.label: Booking app watcher
convex/monitor.ts.summary: Checks on the booking app and opens a case when something looks broken.

convex/permissions.ts.label: Automatic fix permission
convex/permissions.ts.summary: Records whether you've allowed turtl to reuse a saved fix without asking again.

convex/protectedApp/client.ts.label: Booking app connection
convex/protectedApp/client.ts.summary: Defines how turtl talks to the watched app and what counts as fixed.

convex/protectedApp/records.ts.label: Case evidence log
convex/protectedApp/records.ts.summary: Saves evidence, proposed fixes, actions taken and check results for a case.

convex/protectedApp/registry.ts.label: Watched app setup
convex/protectedApp/registry.ts.summary: Registers the demo booking app, its booking journey and the one fix turtl can apply.

convex/runner/contract.ts.label: Step rules
convex/runner/contract.ts.summary: Defines what each case step receives and must return.

convex/runner/handlers/authorize_and_exe.label: Get approval, apply fix
convex/runner/handlers/authorize_and_exe.summary: Waits for your approval, then applies the fix to the booking app.

convex/runner/handlers/detect_or_receive.label: Spot a problem
convex/runner/handlers/detect_or_receive.summary: Starts a case by detecting a failure or receiving a report.

convex/runner/handlers/examine_broader_c.label: Look wider
convex/runner/handlers/examine_broader_c.summary: Checks whether the problem could have other causes or affect more than first thought.

convex/runner/handlers/gather_context.ts.label: Collect clues
convex/runner/handlers/gather_context.ts.summary: Gathers recent errors, settings and past similar cases to understand the problem.

convex/runner/handlers/index.ts.label: Step directory
convex/runner/handlers/index.ts.summary: Lists which piece of code handles each case step.

convex/runner/handlers/investigate.ts.label: Find the cause
convex/runner/handlers/investigate.ts.summary: Studies the clues and names the most likely cause.

convex/runner/handlers/journey.ts.label: Test the booking
convex/runner/handlers/journey.ts.summary: Runs a test booking on the live app to see whether customers can book.

convex/runner/handlers/learn.ts.label: Remember the result
convex/runner/handlers/learn.ts.summary: Saves what happened and what worked so future cases can reuse it.

convex/runner/handlers/plan.ts.label: Plan the fix
convex/runner/handlers/plan.ts.summary: Proposes fix options for you to choose between.

convex/runner/handlers/verify.ts.label: Check it worked
convex/runner/handlers/verify.ts.summary: Rechecks the booking app after the fix to confirm it works again.

convex/runner/run.ts.label: Case runner
convex/runner/run.ts.summary: Runs a case through its steps one after another and records each attempt.

convex/schema.ts.label: Data layout
convex/schema.ts.summary: Defines every kind of information turtl stores and how it is organised.

convex/supermemory.ts.label: Memory search link
convex/supermemory.ts.summary: Sends saved fixes to Supermemory and searches them for similar past problems.

convex/workflow.ts.label: Step order
convex/workflow.ts.summary: Decides which step comes next and when a case waits, finishes or stops.

table:apps.label: Watched apps
table:apps.summary: Stores each app turtl watches, such as the demo booking app.

table:cases.label: Cases
table:cases.summary: Stores every case with its title, kind and status.

table:steps.label: Case steps
table:steps.summary: Stores each step of a case and where it stands.

table:stepAttempts.label: Step attempts
table:stepAttempts.summary: Stores every try at a step, including failures and retries.

table:journeys.label: Customer journeys
table:journeys.summary: Stores the customer journeys turtl tests, such as booking an appointment.

table:actionCatalog.label: Allowed fixes
table:actionCatalog.summary: Stores the fixes turtl is allowed to apply to each app.

table:reports.label: Problem reports
table:reports.summary: Stores reports of failures that start cases.

table:evidence.label: Evidence
table:evidence.summary: Stores clues gathered for a case, like errors and settings.

table:proposals.label: Proposed fixes
table:proposals.summary: Stores fix options offered to you and your decision.

table:actions.label: Actions taken
table:actions.summary: Stores each fix turtl applied and its outcome.

table:verifications.label: Fix checks
table:verifications.summary: Stores the results of checking that a fix worked.

table:recoveryMemories.label: Saved fixes
table:recoveryMemories.summary: Stores what worked before so it can be reused.

table:ownerPreferences.label: Your preferences
table:ownerPreferences.summary: Stores preferences you stated while deciding on a fix, so turtl can follow them next time.

table:permissions.label: Fix permissions
table:permissions.summary: Stores which fixes you've allowed turtl to run automatically.

table:agentRuns.label: AI runs
table:agentRuns.summary: Stores each time an AI model was asked to diagnose or plan.

table:contextSources.label: Clue sources
table:contextSources.summary: Stores where each piece of case information came from.

table:bookingDemoSettings.label: Demo switches
table:bookingDemoSettings.summary: Stores whether suggestions are on and which staged failures are switched on in the demo app.

table:bookingDemoBookings.label: Saved bookings
table:bookingDemoBookings.summary: Stores bookings made in the demo app.

table:bookingDemoAttempts.label: Booking attempts
table:bookingDemoAttempts.summary: Stores booking tries, including failed ones.

external:supermemory.label: Supermemory
external:supermemory.summary: Outside service that stores saved fixes and finds similar past problems.

external:openai.label: OpenAI
external:openai.summary: Outside AI service that helps diagnose problems and powers the chat assistant.

external:keiki.label: Keiki
external:keiki.summary: Outside service that sends you text messages about your cases.

components/feed/plainWords.ts.label: Plain words
components/feed/plainWords.ts.summary: Turns stored facts, checks and error codes into short sentences you can read at a glance.

convex/memory/reset.ts.label: Reset the demo
convex/memory/reset.ts.summary: Clears the booking demo's past cases and history and restores its switches, so the demo can run again.

protected-app/app/index.tsx.label: Booking screen
protected-app/app/index.tsx.summary: The page customers use to pick a treatment and a time, see optional suggestions, and confirm a booking.

protected-app/app/_layout.tsx.label: Booking app shell
protected-app/app/_layout.tsx.summary: Starts the booking app and connects it to its live data.

convex/codeNetwork/graph.ts.label: Code map builder
convex/codeNetwork/graph.ts.summary: Reads the code and works out which pieces use, call, read or save which others.

convex/codeNetwork/build.ts.label: Map the code
convex/codeNetwork/build.ts.summary: Reads the app's code from GitHub, groups it into parts with plain names, and stores it in Supermemory.

convex/codeNetwork/ask.ts.label: Ask about the code
convex/codeNetwork/ask.ts.summary: Answers your question about the whole app, one part or one piece, using the map and the code in Supermemory.

convex/codeNetwork/network.ts.label: Code map records
convex/codeNetwork/network.ts.summary: Stores this map of the code and your questions and turtl's answers about it.

convex/codeNetwork/schema.ts.label: Code map layout
convex/codeNetwork/schema.ts.summary: Defines how the map of the code and its conversations are stored.

convex/codeNetwork/openai.ts.label: Model connection
convex/codeNetwork/openai.ts.summary: Sends one request to OpenAI and returns its written answer.

convex/codeNetwork/dev.ts.label: Load the code map
convex/codeNetwork/dev.ts.summary: Loads the ready-made map of this app's code so the Investigate screen has data without any keys.

table:codeNetworks.label: Code maps
table:codeNetworks.summary: Stores each project's map of its code: parts, pieces and how they connect.

table:codeChatMessages.label: Code questions
table:codeChatMessages.summary: Stores your questions about the code and turtl's answers.

external:github.label: GitHub
external:github.summary: Where the app's code lives; turtl reads it from there to draw this map.
